أستكمن (form X)
# أَسْتَكْمِنُ (ʔastakminu) /ʔas.tak.mi.nu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَكْمَنَ (istakmana)
# أَسْتَكْمِنَ (ʔastakmina) /ʔas.tak.mi.na/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَكْمَنَ (istakmana)
# أَسْتَكْمِنْ (ʔastakmin) /ʔas.tak.min/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَكْمَنَ (istakmana)
